description:
Local OpenAI-compatible router that aggregates free LLM providers.

FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers, plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image, and audio endpoints, behind a single /v1 API.

A router picks the best available model for each request, falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited, and tracks per-key usage so you stay under every free-tier cap. Provider keys are stored encrypted, and the router refreshes its model catalog from a signed feed. Built for personal use only; each provider's terms of service apply.
Tested catalog media routes
- Add NovAI GLM 4.7 Flash chat support in both normal and streaming modes.
- Add ElectronHub FLUX.2 Klein Base 4B image generation.
- Add SilvR Whisper Large V3 transcription.
- Preserve strict model identity checks, bounded image decoding, shared provider allowances and rejection of unapproved routes.
These adapters support the separately published November 16 catalog update: ten tested additions and eight retired Nara routes disabled, net +2 enabled entries.
No catalog rows are hard-deleted. Mistral is unchanged. Premium receives new catalog entries immediately; Free retains the existing 30-day delay. Install this update to use the three new adapter-supported routes.
Existing upstream changes on main since v0.16.30 also include the Claude Desktop /v1 compatibility fix, Windows Store packaging, and documentation improvements.
